blocks.x: How much recording did you do?
Oh quite a bit. I did about two or three record dates there with Louie. Yeah, we did quite a bit of recording.
I'm trying to remember, are you on the Louie Armstrong Plays W. C. Handy record, or Sach Plays Fats records? I can't remember.
I don't know, there's all different kind of tunes. God, I'm on so many of them.
Maybe no, maybe it was Danny.
No, another boy. Didn't stay long. Carl Schiff, something like that. Well anyway, then I think
Yeah, Barrett stayed a little while and then of course Danny Barcelona stayed with him a while.
